text:
Ari: quick poll: planning to do a solo sunrise hike Sat (quiet time) but tempted by a group brunch at 11. whos doing what? :deciduous_tree: :croissant:

Ben: solo hike sounds dreamy. i'm down for quiet time. which trail?

Ari: thinking Ridgeview Loop. ~8km, moderate. parking at Old Quarry lot 6:15am. link: https://trail.example/ridgeview

Kaya: brunch for me (late night coding recovery). will join at 11. any spot recs?

Noah: i can flip a coin but leaning hike. will bring a thermos and granola bars.

reminder-bot: Heads up: Ridgeview trail maintenance ongoing. Expect one short closure near mile 3. Check updates before you leave.

Ari: good note. that closure is a small detour, still fine for the loop.

Kaya: if people want, i suggest "Sun & Sprout" cafe for brunch 11am — good vegan options.

Ben: Sun & Sprout is great. can someone make a calendar invite if we decide brunch?

Ari: i'll hike solo and be at Sun & Sprout by 11:30 if anyone wants to meet after.

Noah: that works. i'll probably join you at brunch after the hike. tagging on a pack of ibuprofen in case of sore legs. :pill:

weather-bot: Saturday 05:30 7 Clear, Temp 80C / 460F, light chill. Sunrise 05:48. Best time for views.

Kaya: i'll aim for brunch 11 at Sun & Sprout. could someone pls DM if plans change?

Ari: will do. also quick trail checklist: headlamp (just in case), layers, hydration, whistle.

Ben: booked a spot at the cafe for 6 ppl just in case. Ari, Noah, Kaya, me, +2 maybe.

Noah: nice. i'll confirm in the morning. have a great hike if solo, Ari! send pics :camera_with_flash:

Ari: will share a couple snaps and a goofy selfie with my muddy boots. :boots: 

Kaya: mandatory brunch photo of avo-toast pls.

reminder-bot: Safety tip: leave your ETA with a colleague if hiking solo.

Ari: ETA sent to my emergency contact and i'll ping here when I'm back. enjoy your weekend everyone!
